text: Nia's cat Biscuit has to go in for surgery on her jaw next Thursday at 10am. Nia is really worried about the anaesthetic. Remind me to text her that afternoon.
Aidan's band is playing The Crown on May 14. He says doors are at 8 and they're on second.
Kenji's dad had a fall at home on Sunday and broke his wrist. He's staying with Kenji and his wife for a few weeks while it heals.
Rana got a new puppy! A cockapoo called Pickle. She picked him up on Saturday and says he hasn't slept through once yet.
Emre is running the Dublin half marathon on October 26th. First time doing that distance and he admitted he's pretty nervous about his knee. Must wish him luck the night before.
Kiara's daughter Phoebe has her first piano recital on June 3rd at 6:30. Kiara's already stressed about getting there from work in time.
Manon is off sick with tonsillitis again. Third time this year. Her GP is finally referring her to ENT.
Need to pick up the dog's flea treatment and drop the car in for its MOT before Friday at noon.
Oisín and his girlfriend Fang have tickets for the Hozier gig on 11/8. They've been waiting for this for over a year.
Arjun mentioned his son has chickenpox, so they've cancelled the birthday party they had planned for this weekend. Should check in with him on Monday.
Fatima's cat is fourteen next week. She does a little cake for him every year, made of tuna. Ridiculous and lovely.
Keisha has her driving test tomorrow morning at 9:15. She's failed twice already and sounded shaky on the phone. Text her good luck first thing.

Grace's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. She was admitted on Tuesday night and they're keeping her in until at least the weekend. Grace is going back and forth every evening after work and is clearly exhausted. I should drop round some food on Thursday so she doesn't have to cook, and maybe offer to walk Bramble, their spaniel, while she's at the hospital.
Kwame is coaching the under-11s and they made the county cup final! The match is Saturday, September 27 at 2pm in Ashford.
Phoebe's play opens on the 12th. She's playing Lady Macbeth, which she's thrilled about. Get tickets for the Friday show.
Simone said Varun twisted his ankle at five-a-side last night. He's on crutches and can't drive for at least a fortnight.
Jamal's tortoise Dexter went missing from the garden yesterday. They've been putting posters up all round the estate.
Lunch with Mia. She's training for a triathlon and has gone fully vegan for it. Doesn't drink at all any more either.

Yusuf's little boy Ethan was taken into A&E on Saturday with a really high temperature. Turned out to be an ear infection and he's home now, but Yusuf is still shattered. Ask him how Ethan is doing when I see him Wednesday.
Rin and Aiko are competing in the regional ballroom championships on March 8. They've been rehearsing every evening since Christmas.
Ravi's grandmother passed away on Friday. The funeral will be in Leicester on the 24th at 11am. Send flowers to his parents' house.
Astrid's dog Luna just had six puppies. She's keeping one and trying to find homes for the rest. My sister might want one.
Mehmet had his knee operation on Monday. Went well apparently, but he's bored out of his mind already. I'm visiting him Saturday afternoon with some films.
Farah's choir concert got cancelled because the venue flooded. They're hoping to reschedule in the spring.
Sadia's brother Kwame is in a jazz trio. They have a residency at Bar Lune on Thursdays starting October 30th. Sadia says he'd love a few friendly faces at the first one.
Ethan's cat has kidney disease. The vet says it's manageable with a special diet, but he's gutted. He's had that cat since uni.
Lukas is doing the Three Peaks challenge for charity on 7/19. Remember to sponsor him before then, ideally when payday hits on the 15th.
Aoife's daughter Grace starts treatment for her asthma at the children's hospital next month. Aoife is trying to stay positive but she's worried about the side effects.
Got the cat booked in for her jabs, Tuesday at 4:40.

Kenji Nakamura, or Ken as everyone at the club calls him, finished fourth at the national judo trials on Sunday. Gutted to miss the podium but it's a personal best. Send him a message to say well done.
Nia mentioned her mum's hip replacement is finally scheduled for November 18th. She's taking two weeks off to look after her.
Aidan's partner Kiara is due in February. They found out it's a girl at the scan last week!
Emre's dog Kofi turns one on Saturday. They're throwing an actual party in the park with dog cupcakes. I'm bringing a squeaky toy.
Varun has been signed off work for a month with burnout. He sounded flat on the phone tonight. I need to ring him again on Sunday evening and make sure he's eating.
Manon said her son Ravi got into the county youth orchestra. He plays cello. First rehearsal is Saturday the 4th at 10.
Rana's dad has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. She's helping him overhaul his diet and is now an expert on carb counting.
Phoebe hinted that she'd love a proper pair of climbing shoes for her birthday. Hers are falling apart. Birthday is August 21st.
Remind me to ask Grace how her mum's scan went on Monday. Results were due at 2pm.

Oisín is playing in the club final against Rathmore on Sunday at 3. His brother Aidan is flying home from Boston to watch. Their dad hasn't missed a match in twenty years, but he's just had a heart scare and the doctors told him to avoid stress, so the whole family is trying to convince him to watch on the stream instead. Oisín is nervous enough without worrying about his dad in the stands.
Dentist moved to 3/12 at 8:30am. Book the afternoon off so I'm not rushing back.
Keisha and her husband Jamal are taking their daughter to see The Lion King on her birthday, December 2nd. It's a surprise.
Kwame's wife Farah has been in and out of hospital with migraines. They still don't know what's triggering them.
Mia's hamster died over the weekend. Her kids are heartbroken. They had a little funeral in the garden.
Yusuf is a huge Arsenal fan. Has a season ticket and goes to every home game with his uncle.
Simone's boss is off on long-term sick leave, so she's been covering his role for the past three weeks. She's hoping it turns into a promotion.
Fang's parrot Mango is having a beak trim at the vet on Wednesday morning. She says he bites everyone except her.
Jamal finished the Manchester 10K in 48 minutes! Massive improvement on last year. Must congratulate him properly when I see him on Friday.
Fatima says her daughter has glandular fever and will miss most of her mock exams in January. The school is being understanding, thankfully.
Astrid and her partner Manon are hosting a fundraiser quiz for the animal shelter on Friday, April 10 at 7:30. Tickets are £10. Don't forget to buy two.
Arjun's son Varun won the under-14 chess tournament in Leeds yesterday! Arjun was beaming.
Lukas's cat Pixel has been off her food since Monday. He's taking her to the vet tomorrow morning at 9.
Aiko's mum is coming over from Osaka for six weeks, landing on May 2nd. Aiko is excited but a bit anxious because her mum has been unwell this year.
Sadia's half term plans fell through. The trip to Lisbon is off because her son broke his arm on the trampoline last Sunday.
Ethan Brennan, my old flatmate, is now a vet nurse in Bristol. Specialises in exotic animals and has a bearded dragon called Kevin.

Picked up Mehmet's spare key so I can feed his cats while he's in hospital. He goes in on Monday at 7am and should be out by Thursday. He gave me a long list: the ginger one, Simba, needs his tablet crushed into wet food twice a day, and the tabby must not be let outside under any circumstances. Text him a photo of them each evening so he doesn't fret.
Farah's dad has been unwell for weeks and they've finally got a diagnosis. It's Parkinson's. She's trying to process it.
Need to call the vet about the dog's limp. Probably nothing but worth checking.
Rin's band won the battle of the bands at the student union last night. They get to record a single at a proper studio in July.

Aoife Santos is doing her grade 8 violin exam on June 16th at 11:20. Her teacher thinks she's ready but she's convinced she'll freeze. Must send her a good luck message the night before, and ask how it went afterwards.
Long walk on Sunday morning, then the vet at 12 with the cat, then the cinema on my own in the evening.
